title: Typed option elimination
contract: An option contains either None or an integer; elimination returns the integer or an explicit absent result, never conflating zero with absence.
scope: None and integers -1,0,1; tagged abstract values only.
assumptions: Exact finite abstract model in scope; no inference to unbounded behavior, LLMLang correspondence or other semantic profiles.

obligations.claim: Presence tag and value preserved; zero is present.

variants.description: Pattern match on an explicit tagged pair.
